finish_summary: 1) bulk_discount_percent returns wrong for qty 50 (got 5 instead of 10). 2) parse_coupon fails for lowercase codes, should be case-insensitive. 3) apply_discount raises TypeError when percent is non-numeric; spec only mentions ValueError for out-of-range, but numeric type check missing. 4) Cart.remove_item leaves quantity zero in dict rather than removing item; violates spec. 5) total calculation: shipping fee applied before coupon reduction, contrary to spec. Also member half shipping logic may be wrong due to earlier errors.
